overview.system_goal: Simulate X comments, replies, feeds, search, bookmarks, notifications and explicit profile-history discovery.
overview.environment_description: Shared content_pool of posts with nested replies; mention_pool queues notifications per user; time advances in scheduled day slices with current_posts windows; seed_root_post_ids frozen from initial env_data for hop-depth metrics.
overview.workflow_structure: Each step: EnvAgent StartEvent → UserAgent (exposure + self-memory + own-post supplementary) + Algorithm (sync posts) → on-demand recommendation/search → propagation & mention side-effects → step advance.

design_concepts.interaction_patterns: Pull-based algorithm recommendations (GetAlgorithmRecommendationEvent), probabilistic social follow feed, mention delivery via mention_pool, optional search continuation, keep-following re-exposure.
design_concepts.communication_protocols: AddCommentEvent and MentionPoolUpdateEvent commit replies; ProfileVisitEvent opens a separate history view.
design_concepts.decision_mechanisms: Baseline Facebook memory and interaction policies; very-high-interest LLM profile/follow decisions; embedding top-five following retrieval.
design_concepts.execution_flow: StartEvent → get_exposure_stream ∥ generate_memory_from_own_posts ∥ supplement_own_posts; StartEvent → Algorithm.update_current_posts; exposure → {AlgorithmRecommendationEvent|SocialRecommendationEvent|BookmarkEvent|SearchResultEvent} → receive_recommendation; exposure → MentionEvent → handle_mention

details.agent_behaviors: UserAgent scans follow feed since last_login_timestamp, requests algorithm types from params, processes mention_pool with attention_budget cap, and runs receive_recommendation / handle_mention with chunked LLM calls. Algorithm agents run random/popularity/interest recommenders and relevant search.
details.decision_algorithms: Popularity: propagation_count distribution + rolling popularity; Random: MAU-weighted sampling; Interest: online BGE cosine coarse-rank on the interest pool then LLM fine-rank, mixed with current_posts_k window posts; Search: embedding relevance to query.
details.specific_constraints: current_posts = posts with time < min(current_timestamp + timestamp_duration, simulation_cap); replies in prompts truncated; simulation capped by max_span_days and max_step from params; pure reposts excluded from text-diversity metrics.
details.process_sequence: 1) Load content_pool & profiles; 2) For each step broadcast StartEvent; 3) User exposure + memory; 4) Algorithm/on-demand feeds; 5) LLM propagation decisions → content_pool & mention_pool; 6) Mention handling; 7) Advance timestamp, rebuild current_posts, save channel snapshots & metrics.

agent_types.UserAgent: X user: Facebook baseline interactions plus deliberate profile Replies visits and strict follow decisions.
agent_types.Platform: Thin router: receives recommendation/search requests and forwards them to platform_agent_0001 / platform_agent_0002. No ranking.
agent_types.Algorithm: Platform agents: platform_agent_0001 (recommendation: random/popularity/interest), platform_agent_0002 (search: relevant).

metrics.name: Diffusion Generation Over Time
metrics.description: Counts propagation-only posts in content_pool: reposts, quotes, and replies (any parent/ref id set). Original posts are excluded.
metrics.calculation_logic: Count content_pool entries with any of reposted_post_id, quoted_post_id, replied_post_id/replyed_post_id set.

metrics.name: Direct Post Pool Count Over Time
metrics.description: Counts non-secondary propagation posts: parent post must be original (no repost/quote/reply parent refs).
metrics.calculation_logic: Propagation posts whose immediate parent is an original post.

metrics.name: Direct Repost Count Over Time
metrics.calculation_logic: reposted_post_id set and parent post is original.

metrics.name: Direct Quote Count Over Time
metrics.calculation_logic: quoted_post_id set and parent post is original.

metrics.name: Direct Reply Count Over Time
metrics.calculation_logic: replied_post_id/replyed_post_id set and parent post is original.

metrics.name: Diffusion Volume Real Time
metrics.description: Propagation posts by post time: cumulative count + histogram (_viz_kind repost_realtime).
metrics.calculation_logic: Collect propagation post timestamps via time_to_ms; twin-panel export in monitor.

metrics.name: User Diffusion Count Frequency
metrics.description: Distribution of seed-attributed propagation entries per user; denominator = all post authors in content_pool.
metrics.calculation_logic: Histogram of per-user propagation totals; raw_data._viz_kind user_repost_count_freq_bar.

metrics.name: Root Diffusion Count Frequency
metrics.description: Distribution of propagation nodes under each env seed root post.
metrics.calculation_logic: Histogram of per-seed-root descendant counts; raw_data._viz_kind root_repost_count_freq_bar.

metrics.name: Diffusion Hop Depth Over Time
metrics.description: Count propagation posts by hop depth vs env seed roots (series hop_1, hop_2, ...).
metrics.calculation_logic: Parent walk repost → quote → reply until seed_root_post_ids; monitor splits hop panels.

metrics.name: Root Author Self-Repost Behavior
metrics.description: Per seed-root author: root_post_count, self_repost_hop_k, repost_on_others_count; CSV + JSONL under root_author_self_repost_behavior/.
metrics.calculation_logic: Returns {users: [...]} table; monitor writes CSV and snapshots.jsonl.

metrics.name: User Received Propagation Frequency
metrics.description: Distribution of one-hop incoming propagation events per user (any parent edge in content_pool); denominator = pool authors.
metrics.calculation_logic: Count propagation posts pointing at each author's post; raw_data._viz_kind received_propagation_freq_bar.

metrics.name: Received Propagation Count Frequency
metrics.description: Dual chart: seed-root descendant counts + seed-attributed one-hop received counts per user (_viz_kind received_propagation_count_freq_bar).
metrics.calculation_logic: Combined root + user received histograms for twin PNG export.

metrics.name: Text Similarity
metrics.description: Mean BGE cosine similarity between generated quote/reply texts and root post reference embeddings.
metrics.calculation_logic: Embed generated texts; align to root post_id in reference embedding JSON; return mean cosine or None.

metrics.name: Text Diversity
metrics.description: Lexical/semantic diversity of generated quote/reply texts: TTR, Distinct-2/3, 1-Self-BLEU, Div_sem. Pure reposts excluded.
metrics.calculation_logic: Collect quote/reply texts; compute diversity metrics; embed via embedding_client; _viz_kind propagation_diversity.

metrics.name: Text Max Reference Similarity
metrics.description: Reference-driven max cosine: each reference post embedding vs same-root simulated comments, then mean over matched posts.
metrics.calculation_logic: Load reference_embedding_path JSON by post_id; embed generated comments; mean of max cosine per reference post.

metrics.name: Same-Post Cross-User Similarity
metrics.description: Cosine similarity between different users on the same post. Mean weights user pairs equally, then eligible posts equally. Max is the highest cross-user comment-pair similarity. Includes all/root/reply scopes and per-post sample counts; insufficient samples are NA.
metrics.calculation_logic: Reuse comment embeddings; exclude same-user and cross-post pairs. Report average and maximum similarity separately.
